purpose: Finite absolute geometry for one B04-C Temporal Constraint window rule MaterialState, with explicit starts_at and ends_at instants.

columns.name: material_state_ref
columns.meaning: MaterialStateRef of the typed window rule state whose absolute geometry is stored here.
columns.value_contract: Exactly one row for every B04-C absolute window rule state.

columns.name: starts_at
columns.meaning: Inclusive lower instant of the canonical absolute window geometry for point-membership relations.
columns.value_contract: Finite timestamptz normalized as an absolute instant; must be strictly earlier than ends_at.

columns.name: ends_at
columns.meaning: Inclusive upper instant for start/completion membership; positive-overlap evaluation remains strict at touching endpoints.
columns.value_contract: Finite timestamptz normalized as an absolute instant; must be strictly later than starts_at.

primary_key.name: pk_temporal_constraint_window_absolute_state
primary_key.reason: At most one absolute geometry payload per typed window MaterialState.

foreign_keys.name: fk_temporal_constraint_window_absolute_state_window_state
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Absolute geometry exists only for a typed window discriminator using temporal_form_code=absolute.

check_constraints.name: ck_temporal_constraint_window_absolute_state_interval
check_constraints.expression_contract: isfinite(starts_at) AND isfinite(ends_at) AND ends_at > starts_at
check_constraints.reason: Window geometry must be finite, non-empty and directionally valid without inventing precision.

indexes.name: pk_temporal_constraint_window_absolute_state
indexes.reason: Absolute window geometry lookup by MaterialStateRef.

triggers.name: ctrg_temporal_constraint_window_absolute_state_rule_totality
triggers.reason: Require exactly one finite absolute geometry payload for an accepted window state and reject mixed-family payloads.

state_history.material_state_behavior: Immutable absolute window geometry owned one-to-one by a window-rule MaterialState.
state_history.current_binding: Currentness is inherited from the owning Temporal Constraint rule state through scoped_current_material_state.
state_history.chronology: The endpoint values describe geometry only; current-history episodes remain chronology authority.
state_history.immutability_policy: Runtime read access is SELECT-only; changing geometry appends a new MaterialState rather than updating this row.

lifecycle.retention: Retained with the owning historical rule MaterialState after revision or retirement.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No runtime DELETE; retirement changes current binding and retains historical geometry.

obligations: starts_at and ends_at are finite absolute instants
ends_at is strictly later than starts_at
geometry remains explicit columns rather than a range whose bound semantics are implicit
positive-overlap semantics are implemented by evaluator logic rather than hidden PostgreSQL range behavior
runtime has only SELECT access needed by the canonical current-rule read model
